name: Smart-Expense-Tracker
description: A clean, modern SaaS personal finance dashboard engineered with a mobile-first approach, localized for Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Features real-time budget spending analytics, dynamic category breakdown, transaction editing, search/filter toolbar, and one-click CSV & PDF export utilities.

paragraphs: A state-of-the-art, client-side personal finance operating system localized for Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Built with a sleek modern SaaS design, featuring Progressive Web App (PWA) offline capability, automated recurring subscription rules, dynamic budget targets & health indicators, interactive 6-month visual analytics, JSON snapshot backup & restore, and professional PDF/CSV statement exports.
🚀 Live Demo • Key Features • PWA & Automation Guide • Tech Stack • Project Structure • Quick Start

Smart Expense Tracker (FinTrack) is an enterprise-grade personal finance application running entirely in your browser. Engineered around clean SaaS design principles (inspired by Stripe, Linear, and CartWise), it provides a responsive, privacy-centric financial dashboard with zero backend dependencies, zero telemetry tracking, and lightning-fast load times.
features: Instant Installation: Installable directly onto mobile devices (Android / iOS) and desktops (Chrome, Edge, macOS) via Web App Manifest (manifest.json).
Offline Reliability: Service Worker (service-worker.js) intercepts network requests with a resilient cache-first strategy, allowing the app to function flawlessly without internet connectivity.
Custom Branding: App icons with high-resolution PNGs (192x192, 512x512) and scalable SVG vector assets.
PWA Status Bar & Theme Color: Native mobile shell experience with theme-color integration (#059669).
Repeat Cycle Support: Schedule transactions as Weekly (every 7 days) or Monthly (same calendar day each month, with automatic day clamping for shorter months).
